facts.fact: Local Ad Extensions can add the advertiser's business address and phone number to an ad when a user is near the advertiser's business location.
facts.quote: if a user is near an advertiser's business location, extended local attributes can be added to the ad to increase interest. This can include the address and phone number of the business.

facts.fact: Advertisers can provide multiple business locations as Location Extensions at the campaign level, and each business location can have its own phone number.
facts.quote: Advertisers can provide multiple business locations as "Location Extensions" at the campaign level, and each business location can have an individual phone number.

facts.fact: Local Ad Extensions are listed as available in the NAR market (US, CA) and the EMEA markets (UK, IE, FR, DE, IT, ES, AT, CH, NO, SE, DK, FI).
facts.value: NAR: US, CA; EMEA: UK, IE, FR, DE, IT, ES, AT, CH, NO, SE, DK, FI
facts.quote: **Markets**: NAR (US, CA), EMEA (UK, IE, FR, DE, IT, ES, AT, CH, NO, SE, DK, FI)

facts.fact: The Local Ads parameter value "LocalAds=Mixed" is case sensitive.
The parameter value "LocalAds=LocalOnly" is obsolete but returns the same result as "Mixed."
facts.quote: "LocalAds=LocalOnly" is obsolete, but will return the same as "Mixed."

facts.fact: Per the vendor's partner case study, partner Barefruit reported that using Local Ad Extensions increased CTR by +11% and RPM by +12%.
facts.quote: Barefruit, used Local Ad Extensions to increase CTR by +11% and increase RPM by +12%

facts.fact: The vendor's Sitelinks product lets advertisers add up to six custom URLs.
facts.quote: Get searchers closer to where they want to be with up to six custom URLS.
